OUTPUT 1.1 Screening for 10 LMMAs have been completed and and selection done on a standardised criteria established by Blue Finance. Screening and feasibility studies have been completed. Apart from the 9 LMMAs at KiW, Blue Finance has completed LMMA screening and pre-feasibility studies for two other sites at Beqa Lagoon Resort in Beqa and Kuata Resort in Yasawa. Target has been acheived as the combined coverage of the Beqa and Yasawa MPAs alone add to more than 500 square meters of LMMAs. The LMMAs add to the 1000 square meters target.
Blue Finance has completed the SPE desgin structure and business model/plan for KiW and the Kuata Resort. SPE at KiW is yet to be established as community is still completing discussions on et up structure and membership of the SPE.
Blended finance solutions have been developed and fundraising for the KiW Beqa Lagoon and Kuata Resort is underway. Mirova Natural Capital, Nature+ and BNPPARIBAS have agreed on the term sheet for an impact loan for a LMMA project on Fiji (same loan conditions as in previous progress report). Blue finance will present in due time the best LMMA project selected.
Multiple stakeholder discussions have taken place. Approximately 15 site visits and community consultations have been done throughout 2022 with project partners and beneficiaries.
OUTPUT 1.2 Buisness Plan/Models for the the KiW and BAD subprojects have been completed. BAD has already progressed to securing debt financing from UNCDF and KiW is in the process of finalising SPE strucuture before incoporating the SPE itself. KiW Business Plan/Model has been completed but need to be finalised in collaboration with the community which is expected to be done in ealry 2023 once community members are available.
Mirova Natural Capital, Nature+ and BNPPARIBAS have agreed on the term sheet for an impact loan for a LMMA project on Fiji (same loan conditions as in previous progress report). Blue finance will present in due time the best LMMA project selected. There is strong interest to invest in Beqa Lagoon and Kuata Resort LMMA/MPAs as the business model allows Blue Finance to be part of the daily management and affaris.
KiW is stagnatig as the Blue Finance Local partner (Victor Bonito) is wishing to create separate entities for the implementation of the LMMA day-to-day activities and the visitor center. This is different from the Blue Finance model and investor’s expectations. Will be harder to implement Bf modus operandi for MPA management (focus on MPA performances, permanent staff), for revenue models and impact standards in K-i-W LMMA context
OUTPUT 1.3 This is nearing completion for BAD as they are in the process of completing the construction of their new research center to support LMMA and MPA stakeholers. SPE office for the KiW, Beqa and Yasawa projects are expected to be self funded by the SPE owners either through debt financign from UNCDF under this programme or through the financing from external sources.
OUTPUT 1.4 No progress has been achieved on this in 2022. However, the project board and the GFCR global Board have agreed to hire a legal consultant. However, the allocation remains zero for now as GFCR has requested that funds for the project be used for more urgent work. Funds from this line item is temporaralily being used for other line items until February 2023.
OUTPUT 2.2 This additional activity is expected to support the business plan/model and pitch to the Fijian Government for co-financing. It is a new acitivity that was added in November 2022 upon clearance form the GFCR Global Board for additional funds. Progress on this will be reported in 2023.
OUTPUT 2.3 These are revised activities that have been approved by the GFCR Global Baord in November 2022. Progress on this will be reported in 2023.
